init.title: ESP32 CC1101 RF Studio
init.description: Choose an action to manage your RF devices or tune radio settings.

manage_devices.title: RF Devices & Remotes
manage_devices.description: Select an existing device to learn, configure or delete its buttons, or type a new device name directly.

create_device.title: Create New RF Device
create_device.description: Enter a name for the device you want to control (e.g. Fan, Blinds, Garage). After creation, open the device to learn its remote buttons.

device_learn_button.title: Learn RF Button: {device_name}
device_learn_button.description: Step 1 of 3: Enter the button name, repeats, and learning signal power filter. When submitted, you will get a button to manually start recording.

device_learn_record.title: Record Button: {button_name}
device_learn_record.description:
Ready to record button '**{button_name}**' for **{device_name}**.

📶 **Active power filter:** `{learn_rssi} dBm` (only captures strong nearby signals; your normal sensitivity is automatically restored afterward).

👉 **Instructions:**
1. Hold your remote 10–30 cm from CC1101.
2. Click **Submit / Start Recording** below when ready.
3. As soon as you click, **hold down the button on your remote continuously for 5 seconds**.

device_learn_failed.title: Recording Failed: {button_name}
device_learn_failed.description:
⚠️ Could not detect a consistent, clean signal.

**Reason:** {error_reason} ({sample_count} bursts received).
**Current power filter:** {learn_rssi} dBm.

If there is noise or distant remotes interfering, you can tune the power filter to restrict strictly to strong signals near the antenna.

What would you like to do?

device_learn_tune_rssi.title: Tune Signal Power Filter: {button_name}
device_learn_tune_rssi.description:
Configure the signal power threshold (RSSI) exclusively for recording this button.

Higher values (e.g. -50 dBm or -40 dBm) strictly restrict recording to strong signals held right next to the CC1101, ignoring ambient RF noise and neighbor remotes.

Once learned, normal sensitivity is automatically restored for long-range remote reception.

device_learn_verify.title: Verify Button: {button_name}
device_learn_verify.description:
✅ Signal captured: **{candidate_desc}**.

Now we will verify that Home Assistant detects your remote correctly.

👉 **Instructions:**
1. Click **Submit / Check Press** below.
2. As soon as you click, press your remote button **ONCE**.

device_learn_verify_failed.title: Verification Not Detected: {button_name}
device_learn_verify_failed.description:
⚠️ Single press was not detected within the timeout (or signal did not match).

To prevent corrupt codes, candidate code has **NOT** been saved.

What would you like to do?

menu_options.device_menu: Cancel and return to device menu

device_learn_success.title: Button Verified Successfully!
device_learn_success.description:
🎉 Button **{button_name}** verified and saved for **{device_name}**.

Confirmed signal: **{candidate_desc}**.

A button entity has been created on your dashboard and device status sensor updated.

What would you like to do next?
